title: A convergent complex analytic germ is differentiable
statement: Work over $\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field]. Let $h:\mathbf C\to\mathbf C$ and let $a\in\mathbf C$. If $h$ is represented on some neighborhood of $a$ by a convergent complex power series centered at $a$, then $h$ is complex differentiable at $a$.
